metadata.operatingStatusNote: Official homepage confirms the eight line names; exact route endpoints/opening status follow OSM and may include planned or stale members. Official homepage currently describes Line 8 south construction; do not present every OSM relation endpoint as operating.
metadata.geometryPolicy: Each segment is an original route-member OSM way. Shared ways are deduplicated within a line. Disconnected/missing members are not joined with straight lines. Underground tracks are projected horizontally to the ground for the optical overlay; actual tunnel elevation is unavailable.
